subject: Recap: Scoutline discovery — priorities, risks, and mutual action plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@scoutline.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@scoutline.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Scoutline discovery — priorities, risks, and mutual action plan

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our 45-minute discovery to make sure we captured the right priorities and agree on next steps. If I missed anything, flag it and I’ll update the shared MAP.

High-level takeaways
- Primary goal: Replace slow on-prem NLU endpoint for customer chat routing to improve median latency from ~1.2s to <200ms and cut inference cost per session by ~45%.
- Main pains: bursty peak traffic (end of month), inconsistent tail latency, limited ability to A/B model variants, and procurement requiring SOC2 evidence + custom contract terms.
- Success metric for pilot: sustained 200ms median, <5% error rate, integration with existing Kafka event stream, and a clear handoff plan for SLA/Dedicated if we scale.

Mutual Action Plan (proposed) — draft milestones
1) Security & compliance checklist completed — owner: Scoutline (security) / Redwood (security eng) — target: 2026-08-18
2) Pilot environment readiness (VPC peering + sample dataset) — owner: Scoutline (platform) / Redwood (solutions eng) — target: 2026-08-20
3) Pilot kickoff (canary with 10% traffic) — owner: Scoutline POC / Redwood on-call — target: 2026-08-24
4) Pilot evaluation (2 weeks, perf + quality) — owner: mutual — target: 2026-09-07
5) Commercial decision / procurement sign-off — owner: Scoutline procurement & Redwood sales — target: 2026-09-14

Immediate asks from Redwood
- Confirm security contact and procurement contact (name + email).
- Share a small sample of the typical request distribution (anonymized) and expected peak QPS.
- Quick check on data residency requirement (US-only? EU?).

Attachments: attached a draft MAP (scoutline-map-v1.xlsx) and an initial pricing estimate (redwood-pricing-estimate-v2.pdf).

If this aligns, I’ll update the MAP with any new owners/dates and send a calendar invite for a short planning call next week to align procurement/security.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: scoutline-map-v1.xlsx (Excel, 38 KB)]
[Attachment: redwood-pricing-estimate-v2.pdf (PDF, 72 KB)]
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@scoutline.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@scoutline.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Scoutline discovery — priorities, risks, and mutual action plan

Ben —

Appreciate the clear recap. High level looks right. A few updates from our side:
- Security lead: Tom Reynolds (tom.reynolds@scoutline.com) — Tom will need SOC 2 artifact and an overview of how you handle KV cache and data isolation for private deployments.
- Procurement/PO: Maya Patel (maya.patel@scoutline.com) — she’ll coordinate commercial terms and timing.
- Pilot timing: Procurement indicates approvals will come through slightly later than we hoped; can we move the pilot kickoff to 2026-08-31 instead of 8/24? We still want the 2-week evaluation window, so that shifts the decision to ~2026-09-21.

Two clarifying Qs:
1) Data residency: we need US-only processing for the first pilot.
2) Can Redwood provide a short SOC2 snapshot (summary doc) we can share with our security team before the full evidence packet?

I’m confirming those owners here so your MAP can be updated. We’re excited to see the latency improvements.

—Liam
Head of Data Products | Scoutline
liam.oconnor@scoutline.com | +1 (617) 555-0110

Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP + SOC2 snapshot and next steps

Liam / Priya / Tom / Maya —

Thanks for the quick responses and for looping in Maya and Tom. I’ve updated the MAP to reflect the new owners and adjusted dates per your note. Key updates below and attachments include the revised spreadsheet (scoutline-map-v1-updated.xlsx).

Revised milestones (high level)
- Security evidence shared: Redwood SOC2 summary (attached link + snapshot) — owner: Redwood security — target: 2026-08-13
- Pilot environment readiness (VPC peering + sample dataset): target: 2026-08-26
- Pilot kickoff (canary 10%): target: 2026-08-31
- Pilot evaluation complete: target: 2026-09-14
- Procurement sign-off / commercial decision: target: 2026-09-21

Answers to your Qs:
1) Data residency: Confirmed — we can restrict processing to US-only regions for the pilot (hosted in our us-west-2 cluster or via a private deployment in your VPC).
2) SOC2 snapshot: Attached brief SOC2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and a link to our compliance portal. If Tom needs a packaged evidence bundle we can schedule a secure SFTP transfer.

Immediate next steps
- Ben / Aditya: schedule a short (30-min) alignment call with Tom + Maya to walk the SOC2 snapshot and outline the network steps (VPC peering, sample data exchange). Proposed windows: Fri 2026-08-07 10:00–12:00 PT or Mon 2026-08-10 09:00–11:00 PT.
- Maya: share procurement cadence and any template PO language that will accelerate the decision.
- Scoutline: confirm a point person to own traffic routing during canary week.

DocuSign / contracting note: I’ll start a redline-friendly SOW and send a DocuSign preview once we’ve locked the pilot dates; that will include standard SLA / fallback policies.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: scoutline-map-v1-updated.xlsx (Excel, 42 KB)]
